ALGER, Un nouveau cheval de Troie bancai: ALGIERS, A new banking Trojan, named Rokarolla, has been identified by Zimperium researchers.
Le malware cible deux cent dix-sept appl: The malware targets two hundred and seventeen banking and cryptocurrency applications. It displays fake login pages to steal user credentials.
Rokarolla se diffuse via des sites web m: Rokarolla is distributed via malicious websites mimicking official Google Chrome or TikTok pages. The user installs a dropper malware before the main virus.
Le logiciel malveillant exploite les per: The malicious software exploits Android's accessibility permissions to interact with installed applications. It features one hundred and thirty-seven commands to control the phone remotely, even when locked.
Les chercheurs de Zimperium précisent qu: Zimperium researchers specify that the list of two hundred and seventeen targets includes international banks and cryptocurrency wallets. The list can be modified at any time by the cybercriminals.
